query: Build a pricing page for a project-management SaaS with three tiers (Free, Pro, Team), a monthly/annual toggle, and an FAQ section. Single self-contained HTML file with inline CSS, no frameworks. Save it as gen-pricing.html.
expected_behavior: [ch1] States a personality and applies it consistently (one radius style, one copy tone)
[ch1] Declares tokens for spacing, font size, weight, radius and shadow, not just color
[ch1] Fewer distinct spacing and font-size values than baseline (metrics.py)
[ch1] No controls for out-of-scope features; shell is minimal and quieter than the core content
[ch2] Exactly one solid primary action per view; secondary outline/low-contrast; tertiary link-style; non-primary destructive actions not big red
[ch2] Data shown without naive 'Label: value' where format/context suffices; remaining labels quieter than values
[ch2] Max 2 font weights (normal + bold), none below 400; 2–3 text color levels
[ch2] No grey/opacity text on colored backgrounds
[ch3] Spacing values all on a non-linear scale (e.g. 4/8/12/16/24/32/48/64…); metrics.py spacing count well below baseline
[ch3] Content blocks have max-widths; nothing stretched full-width without reason
[ch3] Space between groups clearly larger than within (form fields, headings, list items)
[ch3] Sidebar/panels use fixed or max widths, not percentages; explicit sizes per breakpoint
[ch4] Font sizes all on the type scale (12/14/16/18/20/24/30/36/48/60/72 or similar hand-picked); metrics.py font-size count at or below baseline
[ch4] Paragraphs have a max-width in the 45–75ch range; line-height decreases for headings
[ch4] Numeric columns right-aligned with tabular-nums; mixed-size rows baseline-aligned
[ch4] All-caps labels have added letter-spacing; large headings tightened if the family is wide
[ch5] Palette defined up front in OKLCH with grey + primary + semantic shade scales; no pure black
[ch5] Non-focal colored elements (alerts, badges) use dark text on light tint
[ch5] No meaning conveyed by color alone (icons/text alongside)
[fix] Personality line present as a comment at the top of the file
